retrievalProfile.description: A central group portrait rendered as a stone monument within a perforated postage stamp frame against a solid black field.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central rectangular image with perforated 'stamp' edges containing a group of five men rendered to look like stone carvings on a mountain, set against a deep black background with bold, perspective-distorted typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Central stamp-framed illustration against a solid black void
Human faces integrated into a rocky mountain texture
Perspective-skewed display text above the central frame
Small, spaced-out subtitle text below the frame
coreInvariants: Perforated postage stamp border around the central image
Stone-like texture applied to the subjects' skin and clothing
Solid black background surrounding all elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five men arranged horizontally, filling the upper two-thirds of the central stamp frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central postage stamp frame with its distinct white perforated edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the large skewed title at the top, down to the central faces, and finally to the small text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive solid black negative space framing the central square and text elements.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Earth tones (tan, brown, grey in the central illustration)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark background and the bright, textured central image.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy sans-serif and blocky display faces
letterConstructionRules: Top text uses a heavy block style with a 3D perspective tilt
Bottom text is a wide-tracked, lowercase sans-serif
Top text features a metallic or gradient fill
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the main title are sheared to create a sense of depth and upward movement
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy, distorted display face paired with a clean, widely spaced lowercase sans-serif for contrast.
graphicDevices: Barcode-like decorative line at the very bottom

preserve: Perspective tilt of the top text
Wide tracking of the bottom text
avoid: Centering the text inside the stamp frame

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight for the top display text.
Clean base for the wide-tracked lowercase subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a central rectangular illustration of five men's faces carved into a rocky mountain side, surrounded by a white perforated postage stamp border, all set against a solid black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, perspective-tilted blocky title in the top third and a small, widely-spaced lowercase subtitle in the bottom third using vector outlines.

verificationChecks: Does the top text have a perspective tilt?
Are the faces textured like stone?

adjustableVariables: Number of faces in the monument
Angle of the perspective tilt on the title
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
Exact barcode sequence at the bottom

avoid: Blurry edges on the stamp perforations

postGenerationChecks: Verify the perforated edge is consistent around the central image.
Ensure the top text appears to recede into the distance.
Check that the stone texture does not obscure the facial expressions.
Confirm the bottom text is lowercase and widely spaced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central themed illustration + Perforated stamp frame + Solid black field + Skewed display typography.
